entries.text: DAILY-CHECK 2026-08-03: health 7/7 green, gate 70 live (settingsError null), no halt, A+B bridges reporting, syntax clean, no secrets tracked. TOP ISSUE: journal .rr stores the SIGNAL's planned R:R next to the BROKER's realized prices (index.js:2590) — the single journal trade records rr 2.5 while its own prices imply 6.57 and it closed at exactly its stop (-1.0R); get_performance therefore reports avgRR +2.5 on a 0% win rate. This is the mechanism behind the known "rr-artifact" inflation. Also: 2 watchdogs alive (one orphaned, paired heartbeats since 02/08 15:51), saveLearning() swallows all write errors, startup_all.ps1 untagged-bridge warning is a permanent false positive, Brave+Exa API keys invalid.

SESSION 2026-08-03: THREE COMMITS 5b36001, 6c64458, 9d5301a. Every one is a silent-loss or silent-wrong-number bug; none changed signal generation. (1) 5b36001 tasks/daily/2026-08-02.json was INVALID JSON - a hand-appended entry missing its comma - and daily_notes._load_note swallowed JSONDecodeError and returned an EMPTY note. It feeds a read-modify-write (log_entry, auto_log), so the next `daily_notes.py log` would have saved that empty note over the file and erased the entire 08-02 session record. Backed up first, comma restored, both entries intact at 7542 bytes. Parse failure now exits loud and leaves the file byte-identical - verified on a deliberately corrupt fixture. Two more silent failures in the same file: auto_log tested isinstance(trades, list) but /api/journal answers {"journal":[...]}, and filtered on `opened_at` where the journal carries `openTime` - NO TRADE HAS EVER REACHED A DAILY NOTE. _save_note now writes temp+rename. (2) 6c64458 /api/trade-opened copied sig.rr - the SIGNAL's planned R:R - into the journal row beside entry/sl/tp taken from the BROKER's fill. The two described different trades: the only real trade stored rr 2.5 while its own prices imply 6.57, and it closed at exactly its stop for -1.00R. That is the mechanism behind the rr-artifact inflation - /api/stats/by-setup averaged the stored field and reported avgRR +2.5 on a 0% win rate. rr is now derived from the row's own prices, plannedRr preserves the signal's intent, and by-setup derives from prices so rows written earlier are corrected ON READ - journal history is read, never rewritten. Endpoint now returns avgRR 6.6 / avgRealizedR -1.00 for BB_SQUEEZE_WATCH. (3) 9d5301a saveLearning ended in `catch (e) {}` - a locked or unwritable learning.json discarded every recorded outcome with nothing in the log. Both saveJournal and saveLearning also wrote in place, so a crash mid-write truncates the one file CLAUDE.md marks irreplaceable. Both now temp+rename via writeJsonAtomic, traced against overwrite / create / unwritable-path. learning.json verified byte-identical across two restarts except sessionCount 78->79. SERVER RESTARTED TWICE by PID (never /T), bridges untouched and both reconnected; healer 7/7, gate 70, fixedLot 0.01, settingsError null, halted false, all three assets WAIT conf 0 on dataSource mt5. TWO ACTIVE-PRIORITIES ITEMS ARE STALE AND SHOULD BE CLOSED: open item #1 'a candle push does not trigger a signal recompute' is FULLY FIXED on both halves - index.js:2120-2134 recomputes on the yahoo->mt5 transition (observed firing 35s after my restart) and mt5_bridge.py:985-990 refuses to execute a signal stamped dataSource:'yahoo' for a symbol it has pushed bars for. Item #3 'the MCP tools do not exist' is also stale - smartentry MCP is live in .mcp.json. PROCESS HYGIENE: found TWO watchdogs - PID 18912 whose parent was already gone, and PID 20700 supervised by the live guardian 11256. Stopped the unsupervised orphan only; one guardian-supervised watchdog remains. Confirmed exactly TWO bridges (A #25446287, B #11581419) from the tagged .bat launchers - no untagged third.
